entry.title: Is there a winning pattern on the Wheel?
entry.summary: Seven Wheel claims, checked against the server code. No pattern today; before May 2024 the last result hinted at the next one, and some bets paid on average.

entry.title: Slot machines return 91.8%: spin more, lose more
entry.summary: How the slot machine picks symbols and pays out, read from the server code and data. A 2 Scrap bet returns 1.84 on average. No machine or time pays better.

entry.title: When is a crate's loot decided?
entry.summary: When are the contents of Barrels, Military Crates and Locked Crates decided? The server code says at spawn. The opener and the time change nothing.

entry.title: Can you beat blackjack and poker by counting cards?
entry.summary: From the server code, the blackjack deck is rebuilt and reshuffled every round, so counting cards gives no edge. The house edge is about 0.8%.
